parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs universal federal binary-sex document and government-facility rules, entry refusal and possible permanent fraud ineligibility for document discrepancy, and documented severe custody harm, with a state K-12 bathroom ban and minor-care ban. Courts, injunctions, local ordinances, and the absence of a documented adult facility ban in this division mitigate, but do not cancel, those traveler-facing exposures. No execution or routine imprisonment for identity is documented, so risk sits near the 0.35 anchors, above 0.25 custody/extortion regimes.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal policy defines sex as binary at birth, stops new X or mismatched markers, and Supreme Court allowed restrictions in Nov 2025; cable directs refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Passports confiscated or blocked left some stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid to expiry; civil-liberties suit challenges policy; limited waivers possible for fraud ground; legal-aid FAQ exists.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can become refusal, investigation, additional-evidence demand, or alleged misrepresentation triggering detention or lifetime ineligibility.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National custody adopted conversion-therapy model including hair cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric drugs; immigration custody reports include forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse; a bathroom trespass arrestee was held 24 hours in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Some executive orders blocked or enjoined; courts hear challenges; no documented traveler-specific consular or custody-placement protection in dossier.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry or facility encounter can escalate to detention, where birth-sex placement and documented abuse increase severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with gender identity; 21 state/provinces mapped with government or school bans, 4 with criminal liability in circumstances; this division bans trans students using bathrooms inconsistent with birth sex in public schools.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This division documents no adult-wide bathroom rule; 29 state/provinces plus capital have no mapped ban; criminal trespass in cited state requires willful entry plus refusal to depart when asked.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings and schools expose every traveler regardless of local adult law; private settings in this division are not documented as banned.

care_services.exposure: Division bans puberty blockers and hormones for trans minors with no phase-out for those already treated, in force since July 2023; national orders restrict minors' care and proposed rules would bar public insurance for under-18 care.
care_services.protection: No adult care ban documented in this division; care-ban litigation continues and some national orders enjoined.
care_services.interaction: Adult traveler care exposure is not_documented as banned locally; a traveling minor may face denial or interruption interacting with school/facility rules.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders remove gender-identity protections, direct investigation and possible criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating transition, and 2025-26 counterterrorism guidance prioritizes radically pro-transgender groups for neutralization.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked or enjoined; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; same-sex marriage recognition and 2020 employment ruling remain.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases police, school and agency discretion to treat gender expression as fraud, ideology or security risk.

minors_guardians.exposure: Trans minor traveler/guardian faces school bathroom and sport restrictions if enrolled, in-state care ban, national directives to investigate schools and prosecute facilitating teachers, and hospital-record subpoenas for minors.
minors_guardians.protection: Parents sued over care ban; conversion therapy on minors banned statewide since Sept 2024; appellate review left ban in force in 2023 but later status not established.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian seeking continuity of care or school access can become subject to investigation, record disclosure, or service denial.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2025 polling shows 66% support birth-sex on government documents; this division's hate-crime statute excludes gender identity, so no state enhancement; only 23 state/provinces cover gender identity in bias statutes.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute applies; 19 municipalities have gender-identity non-discrimination ordinances in employment, housing and public accommodations; national employment appellate ruling protects workers.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Local hate-crime exclusion and religious-freedom statute may weaken police enhancement and service-refusal recourse outside ordinance cities.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport, executive-order and health-rule challenges unresolved; Supreme Court allowed passport restrictions; which measures are in effect at travel time is uncertain.
remedies_unknowns.protection: ACLU suit, injunctions on some orders, appellate employment precedent, legal-aid guidance, and municipal ordinances provide partial recourse.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are slow and fragmented across federal, state and municipal levels and rarely reverse entry refusal, facility exclusion, or custody placement in real time.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine state stops, document scrutiny and humiliation without likely imprisonment; here entry fraud-ground risk and federal facility ban are more formal and universal, but court remedies are stronger.

Higher risk than 0.55-B: secondary screening there is usually administrative refusal with appeal desk; here discrepancy can trigger refusal plus possible permanent ineligibility and documented severe custody abuse.

Similar custody severity to 0.25-C birth-sex housing and assaults, but lower than 0.25 overall because imprisonment is not routine, execution is not credible, and functioning courts have enjoined measures.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document or presentation mismatch at federal entry, federal facilities, or school facilities, escalating through refusal, investigation, possible fraud finding, or detention where birth-sex placement and documented abuse matter. Local adult protections and municipal ordinances help in limited settings, while the division adds minor-specific care and school exposures. Courts provide real but slow partial recourse, placing the combined regime in High Risk near 0.37.
